meta.name: pith-authoring
meta.description: Pith is an authoring-layer discipline, opt-in at the builder (spec/pith.md). technical-prose-verbatim was sealed by the DEFAULT builder: its event summary carries dots inside an identifier (ledger.entry_audit) and decimals (12.4k, 14.11, 16.4), stored byte-identical to what the author wrote, with no pith_normalized_fields member — the pre-fix default normalizer rewrote exactly this prose to 'ledger. entry_audit ... 12. 4k ...' and silently deleted trailing sentences inside the hash chain. pith-normalized-marker was sealed with pith enabled: its summary was genuinely rewritten, so the event carries pith_normalized_fields ['payload.summary'] (spec/chain.md), an optional advisory member covered by the event hash like any other. Independent implementations MUST verify both ok:true; a failure means the lane rejects or re-projects an optional event member and diverges from the signed bytes, not that a capsule was tampered with.
meta.no_warranty: Conformance fixtures only; not production templates or advice.
